title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Gold-led risk rotation, semis cracked, megacap tape thinned. Tech's 5-day melt-up stalled as defensive metals absorbed flows, with breadth narrowing into the close despite record-index momentum.

INDICES — VIX 15.8, down from 17.2 20-day MA. Ranked: DIA +0.44%, SPY -0.20%, QQQ -0.90%, IWM -0.64%, SOXX -2.12%. Large > small by 0.44pp. Gold +4.14%, oil -0.78%. SPY above 200-day, QQQ above 200-day.

VOLUME — SPY vol 1.2x avg, QQQ 0.8x — SPY accumulation, QQQ low-conviction decline. GLD 2.4x with price +4.14% = strong accumulation; XLK 0.8x confirms fading tech interest.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +1.27%, XLB Materials +1.23%, XLY Discretionary +0.30%, XLF Financials +0.21%, XLRE Real Estate +0.07%, XLI Industrials -0.03%, XLP Staples -0.05%, XLK Technology -0.53%, XLU Utilities -1.02%, XLC Comms -1.04%, XLE Energy -2.07%. Top: GDX +7.39%, SILJ +6.28%. Bottom: WGMI -4.78%, MSOS -7.13%. Money into gold miners and healthcare, out of energy and cannabis — rotation-state label: 'defensive risk-off'.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR_vol 1.42 elevated protection, skew +3.7% positive fear. GEX flip 778 vs spot 773 — price sitting just below gamma flip, dealer hedging amplifying downside. VIX 15.8 below 20-day MA, complacency despite gold surge. MOVE 73.6 above 20-day — bond vol stress noted.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold +4.14% with dollar -0.25% — classic flight from USD into hard assets while equities stall. Oil -0.78% failing to follow gold, confirming Mideast-deal de-escalation separate from metal bid.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 65.9 Greed. Movers: AEM +9.85% (Fingold stake deal), UBER -5.29% (legal/regulatory risks, 3.3x vol = distribution), LLY +4.86% on 2.8x vol spike. Watch: GDX +7.39% vol 2.5x vs gold ETF — miner leverage extends, IWM -0.64% below gamma proximity, ANET +3.57% vol 2.8x buildout momentum intact.
